# corpus-bad-duplicate-id - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the executor reading task ids.
**Outcome:** two different tasks claim the same execution id.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；3 个实施 todo；两个 todo 使用同一个 id。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 每个任务的执行身份唯一。 | 1 交付。 |
| GAP-1 | 任务 id 在执行账本中冲突。 | 1 关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1
- Wave 2: task 2

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: 2
